_comment: ACCEPTED FINDINGS -- the kit's known defect debt, as measured by tools/harness.py. tools/verify/verify_findings.py fails on anything NOT in this file, so a new dead control, a new raise, or a new layout spill breaks the build instead of printing into a run nobody reads. It also fails on entries here that no longer occur: debt that was paid and not written off makes the list longer than the kit's real problem, which is how a defect register stops being read. A signature is 'page | category | label' -- the harness's own ids renumber whenever a page changes, and a label is what a maintainer actually searches for. ADDING TO THIS FILE IS ACCEPTING A DEFECT. Do it deliberately, and prefer fixing.

known.selection-log.html: row2 spills at 390px once a record is in the row -- the flex-chain repair ADR-103 named and deliberately left; 37px is the worst in the kit
known.survey-design.html: the same row2 family, 9px, on the copy/remove buttons of each row
known.ecology-lab.html: two textarea fills time out in the Workbench; the controls work by hand
known.field-notebook.html: Undo and Copy CSV leave no observable trace the general oracle can see
